wonderful experience so far, all the staff I have  spoken too so far is very engaged. Whenever i needed help or clarification they have been right on it. Dr. Shah and Sam were so helpful with Gizmo! Would recommend to anyone. :)

In honor of Roy, I feel I need to share our experience.

For over two months, we kept bringing Roy to this clinic looking for answers. Instead of getting a diagnosis, we were repeatedly asked to pay for more tests and procedures while his condition continued to worsen. In the end, Roy was suffering from prostate cancer, something that was never identified despite all the time, appointments, and money we invested.

What made this even more painful was receiving calls recommending even more X-rays and additional testing when what we truly needed was answers and honest guidance.

I am sharing this so other pet owners can make informed decisions. In our experience, we did not receive the level of care, transparency, or urgency that Roy deserved. Losing a beloved pet is heartbreaking, and I hope no other family has to go through what we did.

Roy is finally at peace with his Creator. I only wish he had received the compassionate and effective care he needed while he was still with us.

I’ve been taking my dog Chowder to Wagnolia for the past seven years - Dr. Joshi and her crew are wonderful. They’re thorough, kind, and have my dog’s best interests in mind always. They have many treatment options and don’t pressure one way or the other. Highly recommend them!

I have been taking my dogs there since I adopted my first one back in 2020. My girls are very anxious about going to the vet, but they provide calming music, cushy blankets, and a dark room for them to relax prior to being seen. Dr. Joshi came up with a good plan to relieve their anxiety so that they are able to accomplish everything in one visit without coming back. Yes, they are a little on the pricey side, but they are a small business and can’t buy in bulk like other vets. They go through everything on a treatment plan BEFORE doing anything, so that there are no surprises. The level of care and detail all of the staff show towards my girls is exceptional.

Wagnolia is a small, personalised, caring local vet. My dog is my family, and Dr Joshi, Dr O Brian, Karina and honestly the entire staff have been patient and compassionate with us. I never feel rushed; everything is always thoroughly explained, and I am so grateful for the level of care we receive there. I cannot recommend Wagnolia enough.
This place is wonderful!  Everyone is caring, communicative, professional!

Thank you so much for taking the time to review us!

Sincerely,
Doctors and Staff at Wagnolia Veterinary Clinic

They tried to charge double what they initially quoted for a routine neuter on an otherwise healthy young cat. Their pricing is random, arbitrary, and unpredictable. This is such a shady operation, I wouldn’t recommend anyone bring their pet here.

Wagnolia is a personable, thoughtful, and communicative clinic. My dog had a dental exam there and throughout the procedure and after they checked in to see he was healing and made sure medications were working for him. They were flexible, provided options, and made us feel listened to. Huge thank you to Dr. O’Brian and Karina for their time and care!

Dr. Joshi and the team at Wagnolia have been wonderful for both of my dogs. We came to Chicago knowing that both girls had complicated medical histories, and we were nervous about finding a vet who would be a good fit. Working with Dr. Joshi over the past few years has been a game changer. She recommended many preventative measures that have kept both girls healthier and happier, and have significantly lessened the chronic ear and skin infections they both previously experienced. I wholeheartedly recommend!
